subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should Copilot native web search replace managed search from model-name inference alone, or require verified provider capability with managed fallback?
rationale: Copilot intentionally permits synthetic and plan-dependent models, so this permanent default determines whether existing search behavior may be removed before hosted-search support is known.

options.title: Capability-backed fallback
options.body: Use a Copilot-owned catalog or account capability and retain managed search for unknown or unsupported cases.

options.title: Approve name inference
options.body: Treat provider, API, and model-name matching as sufficient and intentionally accept unsupported model, plan, or account failures.

options.title: Pause for provider contract
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open until maintainers establish a stable capability and Plugin SDK boundary.

recommendation.title: Capability-backed fallback
recommendation.body: Use a Copilot-owned catalog or account capability and retain managed search for unknown or unsupported cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history most directly connects this person to both the shared payload-patch helper and the Copilot provider-stream path.
